name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the leg curl seat so your knees align with the machine pivots and your back rests against the pad.
Position the roller just above your heels, secure the thigh pad and hold the side handles.
Flex your knees smoothly to pull the roller down and back underneath the seat as far as comfortable, squeezing your hamstrings strongly.
Control the lever slowly back to near full leg extension without letting the weight stack bang.
tips: Keep the thigh pad locked tight against your quads so your hips cannot lift during the curl.
Pause briefly at peak contraction and resist the return phase smoothly.
